figurative_meaning_en: at least, despite all the haggling or cutting, at most
example_sentences_in_bangla: মেরেকেটে পঞ্চাশ জন লোক আসবে বলে মনে হয়।
এই কাজটি মেরেকেটে দিন শেষ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: At most, fifty people will come, I think.
This work will finish by the end of the day, give or take.
note: This idiom likely originates from rural market bargaining scenes where quantities are roughly estimated amid haggling.
